title: Device-resolved budgets for the exact circuits: 2x2 on Heron, 2x3 on an all-to-all RZZ device, shot rule and S3 job size

criteria.name: 2x2/Heron (FakeFez snapshot): mean clean-shot fraction f over the 28-circuit set
2x3/all-to-all at the declared eps2 = 0.001: mean f over the 44-circuit set
2x2: CZ of the k = 1 coarse step routed on the ideal heavy-hex d=3 map
2x3: CZ of the k = 1 coarse step, all-to-all CZ basis
2x3: shots per sector from the shot rule (worst sector)

assumed_inputs.note: eps2, eps1, eps_ro are vendor-class SPECIFICATIONS for the all-to-all trapped-ion device, declared inputs of this gate, not measurements; p, k and the confidence are the preregistered shot rule of manual Step 4.4.  The 2x2/Heron f is NOT in this list: it is computed from the per-edge and per-qubit errors of a calibration snapshot (FakeFez / FakeTorino).

2x3.device: all-to-all trapped ion, native RZZ, declared two-qubit error eps2

device_time_illustrative.formula: device time [min] = N_sector / throughput [shots per minute]
device_time_illustrative.label: ILLUSTRATIVE: the throughputs below are round numbers, NOT device specifications

per_shot_cost_2x3.simulator: AerSimulator(method='statevector', CPU), depolarizing model of the declared inputs applied to rzz, rz, rx, ry plus readout flips
per_shot_cost_2x3.note: single-shot trajectory sampling on this laptop CPU; the intended executor is Aer GPU with batched shots on the RTX 3070 desktop (the GTX 1060 Max-Q of this laptop is compute capability 6.1 and no compatible qiskit-aer-gpu wheel exists for qiskit 2.5.2, see prompts/LOG.md)
